scope: Local physical/topology delta; not a complete revised wire ABI or a substitute for native schematic/PCB evidence.
authorization: Latest user directs one custom active motherboard, commodity replaceable modules and all twelve motor interfaces on that motherboard; this supersedes the IS-1 passive rack/card and removable motor9-12 physical arrangement.
frozen_source_policy: Read-only external IS-1; archived exact files under reports/motherboard-is2-contract-20260930/inputs. No external file changed.

boundary_transitions.new: One active custom motherboard with labelled pluggable field terminals and commodity module sockets
boundary_transitions.disposition: Physical rack, DIN/HB/H15 card connectors, guides/levers and redundant slot feeds removed from the new BOM; machine domain isolation/protection stays.

boundary_transitions.new: Soldered power, compute-bay interface, FPGA/clock/flash/supervision motherboard regions
boundary_transitions.disposition: Only the purchased compute module is replaced independently; a soldered FPGA fault requires motherboard repair or replacement.

boundary_transitions.new: Twelve fully fitted motor interface paths and all XM0-XM11 plugs on the motherboard
boundary_transitions.disposition: Eight-plus-four removable motor-card topology and purchase dependency superseded.

boundary_transitions.new: Soldered encoder/fast-input, DI/safety, two DO banks and analog/process/comms regions
boundary_transitions.disposition: MCUs/Ioff/isolators/supervisors may remain where justified; physical card boundaries are removed, electrical isolation is not.

boundary_transitions.new: Purchased replaceable ESP32 board/module in a reviewed motherboard socket/interface
boundary_transitions.disposition: No custom ESP daughterboard required; exact purchased module, socket, pin map, power/reset/USB and antenna clearance remain to select.

boundary_transitions.new: Replaceable commodity storage/settings provision with protected, power-loss-tolerant configuration/history
boundary_transitions.disposition: No silent equivalence between a generic SD/SSD and the old protected-memory guarantee; storage architecture/capacity/endurance/recovery still require qualification.

boundary_transitions.old: EX8 + encoder XTB, XS DIN slot
boundary_transitions.disposition: Keep logical growth/capacity; do not create a new family of custom cards or advertise a connector before selection and qualification.

functional_requirements.function: Differential STEP/DIR, individual enable and alarm
functional_requirements.note: M0-7 and M8-11 are motherboard banks A/B, not removable MIA/MX4. All twelve hardware paths are fitted; no paid unlock or motor-card purchase is introduced. Channels are not axes.
Protected port supplies and validity/age retained. Commanded motor position is not measured encoder feedback.

Preserve the ability to use twelve motor interfaces with encoder growth. No custom EX8/XTB family or guaranteed standard socket has been selected. Optional accessory must carry declared timing, isolation, identity and fault behavior.
Do not consume general DI for dedicated drive alarms, safety interface or fast probes. NPN/PNP selectable hardware is FIO-P1, not an already fitted capability.

TPS274C65ASRHAR remains the selected sourcing baseline. Keep current/fault/temperature/supply diagnostics and independent inhibition. Paired ILIM constraints require versioned configuration validation; 1/2 A, AUX12 and sinking options remain separate unqualified proposals.

functional_requirements.function: Two fast probes, two differential frequency inputs, dedicated MPG and pendant
functional_requirements.note: Retain coherent capture, typed supplies, accessory identity, debounce/staleness and marker/double-read rules where serial status registers are retained.
PWM inhibits low; PROC_PERMIT and output/path latches gate contacts in hardware. PROCESS_PERMIT does not become a generic spindle stop.
Retain AO safe-zero clamp, AI range/calibration/age and protected sensor supply. Exact ADC and total isolated power/cost remain open.
Ordinary replaceable third-party peripherals remain allowed. Profile rates/termination/error/age apply; fieldbus is never the only machine run-enable or a path into the servo thread.

functional_requirements.function: Hardwired machine permission and feedback interface
functional_requirements.note: Independent receiver defaults and onboard safety-domain health replace DIC card presence. Motherboard is not a certified machine safety controller.

functional_requirements.function: Separate protected entries and chassis/shield strategy
functional_requirements.note: Physical entry/bank fuses plus coordinated electronic protection, measured flags/age and fail-closed defaults. Whole-assembly rail/current/thermal budgets must be rebuilt; old rack connector and slot-feed costs are not reused.

logical_contract_inheritance.inhibit_definition: t0 to last of: TX_PERMIT low at all card gates; STEP/DIR high-Z (|VOD|<0.2 V); EN_NO open (<=1 uA at 24 V); EN_NC closed (loop current in 1 k test load); DO off (<1 mA into declared test load); PWM low; process open; AO <=0.1 V; last STEP edge
logical_contract_inheritance.watchdog_progress: Only accepted motion/full-I/O transactions produce the corresponding progress; external clock-independent watchdogs and separate motion/output latches retained.

leakage_allowance.requirement: CWD node guard ring to the GND reference, no-clean residue removed, conformal coating kept off the CWD node; Codex states the leakage budget at 55 C and 85 % RH

watchdog_components_reference.wdo_reset: wired-AND on one 10 k pull-up node then Schmitt: WD_x_OK = WDO AND RESET
watchdog_components_reference.latching: WD_M_OK is a term of latch_clear_n (arm_latch_M) and WD_O_OK of latch_clear_O_n (arm_latch_O); each arm latch holds the fault until a new deliberate request, so a WDO pulse never re-enables permission by itself
watchdog_components_reference.wdi_buffer: SN74LVC1G34 with 100 k pull-down (Codex existing arrangement)
watchdog_components_reference.trip_flag: sticky SN74LVC2G74 set when WD_x_OK falls while SET1 high, cleared by FPGA after host stores event

host_link.physical: one SPI bus, mode 0, MSB first, active-low chip selects, FPGA oversampled at 50 MHz core; SCLK <= core/8 = 6.25 MHz; budget cases 5.00 and 6.25 MHz

CS_FB.response_magic: CNF3 (or a page: CAP3, FLT3, IDP3, card MAINT response)

rules: exact length per chip select (1408 or 768 rising SCLK edges); shorter, longer, early release or both chip selects asserted together: rejected, LINK fault
snapshot at synchronized CS assertion; commit only after CS release with exact length, CRC and semantic validation
CS guards >= 8 core ticks before the first rising edge and after the last falling edge, >= 8 ticks high between transactions
big-endian fields; u24 counters are low 24 bits of 32-bit FPGA counters, unwrapped by the host modulo 2^24
one sequence counter shared by both chip selects: next = last + 1, nonzero, no wrap; FB_READ, READ_PAGE, MAINT and NOP use sequence 0 and do not advance it
ABI byte 0x03 in every frame; no fallback to ABI 1 or 2 (CNC1_BAD_CAPS)
per_cycle_order: cnc1.read: CS_FB FB_READ (event ack) -> CNF3 feedback
LinuxCNC motion, kinematics and HAL functions
cnc1.write: CS_CMD UPDATE (rates + outputs) -> CNS3 (event, telemetry, timing)

logical_contract_inheritance.host_link_note: Inherit CNC3 dual-CS length/CRC/semantic discipline as the baseline. Removed rack fields require explicit versioned capability/diagnostics semantics; this file does not authorize ABI3 to misreport rack identities.
io_validate_before_commit: complete 40-byte frame, CS released after exactly 320 clocks, no SPI overrun
epoch == current epoch (SYNC: new nonzero epoch with sequence 0)
class semantic checks (output bits within the configured mask, AO code <= configured maximum)
only then: apply outputs, reload the accept timer, refresh the IWDG, store epoch/sequence

io_watchdog_reference.accept_timer: firmware timer reloaded only on a fully accepted frame; 1.0 ms (10 link periods); expiry: outputs off, FAULT_LATCHED until a new SYNC epoch
io_watchdog_reference.iwdg: STM32G0 independent watchdog, hardware-started by option byte; in the application it is refreshed only in the accept path; maximum timeout <= 2 ms over the LSI tolerance [REQ]; reset leaves CARD_EN low. In the bootloader (outputs off, CARD_EN low) flash erase and program run from an SRAM routine with interrupts off that refreshes the IWDG while polling the flash busy flag, so a page erase longer than the IWDG timeout never resets the card
io_watchdog_reference.hardware_gates: output enable = qualified OUT_PERMIT_k (hardwired, section 04) AND OUT_EN latch Q AND CARD_EN (MCU pin with pull-down). The OUT_EN latch (one half of an SN74LVC2G74DCUR on each DO and ACC card) has D = 1, CLK = MCU OUT_EN_ARM strobe, asynchronous CLR_N = the qualified OUT_PERMIT_k net, so any accepted OUT_PERMIT_k drop, however short, turns the outputs off and keeps them off; the MCU reads Q, reports the drop (realtime b6 of the status byte), writes SW_STATE = 0 and re-arms the latch only in ACTIVE after a new epoch and IO_ENABLE. The ACC uses the second half the same way for PROC_PERMIT (PEN latch)

diagnostics: real acquisition or qualified hardware flag
validity and data age on every displayed measurement
measured facts separate from AI diagnosis
no reported contact measurement where only command state is available
recovery: no automatic motion or output restart
loss of position continuity unhomes affected joints
calibration and machine lineage retained and revalidated
public_service: AI optional and cannot bypass protection

implementation_conflicts.subject: Card presence, class and installed masks
implementation_conflicts.required_change: Define motherboard hardware revision and real onboard functional/rail qualification separately from removable-module presence. Do not tie missing MIA/MX4/DIC/etc presence pins true or emulate their MIR-1 identity. Installed motor mask follows all twelve actually fitted/qualified paths; armed/configured mask may use fewer.

implementation_conflicts.subject: Permission equations and bank-B OE
implementation_conflicts.required_change: Replace each obsolete card-present/tamper term with an explicitly reviewed onboard domain health/default/fault latch term. Keep rail/CDONE/endpoint/WD/EXT_PERMIT cuts, actual bank-B qualification and OPI_BOE interruption detection; do not remove it merely because the connector disappears.

implementation_conflicts.subject: Serial I/O controllers and identities
implementation_conflicts.required_change: Retain deterministic IOL1 L0-L3 behavior initially, if these local controllers remain fitted; use a versioned soldered-domain identity/port binding and real health/revision. Never fabricate removable slot straps or card EEPROM success. CRC, class/epoch/sequence/freshness, validate-before-commit, local watchdogs and hardwired enable gates remain mandatory.

implementation_conflicts.subject: DO shared current limits
implementation_conflicts.required_change: Represent or reject shared paired ILIM resources before apply. Selected AS chip cannot supply arbitrary independent per-channel trip settings or the 2 A proposed load tier. Preserve 0.5 A/channel and 2 A/four-channel group.

implementation_conflicts.subject: Offline replacement and configuration
implementation_conflicts.required_change: Revise replaceable-unit list to motherboard, purchased compute/service/storage and qualified accessories. Preserve plug-by-plug harness retention, machine lineage/configuration, protected calibration, offline entitlement and deliberate recommissioning. Old five-minute per-card spare/service claims no longer apply to soldered regions.

implementation_conflicts.subject: Module selector and bootstrap
implementation_conflicts.required_change: Implement qualified common-subset/default-off compute routing, stable cold-start selector, independent or safely bootstrapped identity cross-check and matching module OS. Wrong/reserved/ambiguous selection stays inhibited/service-only. Supported compute swap requires no FPGA/ESP reflash; new support still requires qualification.

implementation_conflicts.subject: FPGA pin/bank allocation and timing
implementation_conflicts.required_change: Reconcile source schematic/native PCB/RTL wrapper/vendor pin file for all twelve motor paths, four base encoders, full IO and revised health/status. Optional encoder growth may reserve resource capacity but no old unproven ball allocation becomes approved. Native synthesis and vendor fit/timing plus physical transport/load measurements required.

implementation_conflicts.subject: RGB and actual state observations
implementation_conflicts.required_change: Implement ordinary seven RGB indicators plus input/output/alarm and independent WDT indications, with powered hardware fault-red override. LED/UI healthy states follow measured/qualified observations with validity/age; no decorative status chain substitutes for protection.
